propositions: Mapped project keys that are nonexistent or invisible to the bridge bot are not validated before reconcile pass mutations, causing failures deep in fan-out as ACLI errors instead of failing closed at preflight.
The legacy_default project returned unvalidated by resolve_project can point to a wrong or nonexistent project, driving unguarded mass CREATE operations into the wrong target.

A reconcile-pass preflight must enumerate and validate all required projects (mapped keys, fallback query_project when projects empty, and legacy_default) are bot-visible via GET /rest/api/3/project/search before any outbound Jira mutation occurs.

Preflight probe failures (missing projects or transport errors) must abort the pass with an actionable error message and distinct exception type, converting to OPERATIONAL_FAILURE PassResult, never crashing or proceeding to reconcile_once.
Preflight is gated on backend type (jira only), mutating-pass signal (not preview/dry-run/reconcile-check), and client capability, with observable skip when conditions not met.

Pagination over project/search endpoint must fail closed on page-cap exhaustion without partial key set, and transport faults from _direct_rest_get must be caught and mapped to TransportUnavailableError separate from ProjectVisibilityError.
